item.title: Version 1.0.14
item.description:
• Local intelligent search in the library and Spotlight, with Words and Meaning filters.
  • Smart spaces, automatic tag suggestions and on-device summaries when Apple Intelligence is available.
  • Drag files and folders into Vault0; capture browser links and copied content from the notch.
  • Faster preview caching and smoother scrolling, with fixes for grid edges and context menus.
  • Refined Info and Similar panels, Liquid Glass controls and expanded item menus.
  • Seven interface languages and an expanded AI model catalog.
  • Updated What's New panel and corrected sidebar tag counts.

item.title: Version 1.0.13
item.description:
• Find similar images, links, and notes with a local model and stricter relevance filtering.
  • Download progress and animated Similar results.
  • Remember the Info or Similar panel, its width, and whether it is open.
  • Floating Liquid Glass controls for images, PDFs, and links.
  • Blue selection border for context menus and improved detail headers.
  • A unified library with All, Pinned, Inbox, and Later; the app opens directly in All.

item.title: Version 1.0.12
item.description: Includes the latest Vault0 improvements and fixes.
